units.source_text: 夕雾昔年向云居雁求婚不成，两人隔绝的时候，曾经私下和这典侍通情，但亦只此一人。

en.t: In earlier years, when Yugiri had failed in his suit to Kumoi no Kari and the two were kept apart, he had secretly had relations with this Naishi, but she was the only one.

units.source_text: 后来求婚成功了，他就逐渐疏远她，难得和她相聚。

en.t: After his courtship succeeded, however, he gradually drew away from her and seldom spent time with her.

units.source_text: 然而藤典侍也生了许多孩子。

en.t: Even so, To no Naishi had borne him many children.

units.source_text: 云居雁所生的男孩有大公子、三公子、四公子、六公子，女孩有大女公子、二女公子、四女公子、五女公子。

en.t: The sons born to Kumoi no Kari were the eldest young lord, the third, the fourth, and the sixth; her daughters were the eldest young lady, the second, the fourth, and the fifth.

units.source_text: 藤典侍所生女孩有三女公子、六女公子，男孩有二公子、五公子。

en.t: The daughters born to To no Naishi were the third and sixth young ladies, and her sons were the second and fifth young lords.
There were twelve children in all.

units.source_text: 其中不像样的一个也没有，都长得非常可爱。

en.t: Not one of them was disappointing, and they all grew up to be wonderfully charming.

units.source_text: 尤其是藤典侍所生的，相貌清秀，性情贤惠，个个都很出色。

en.t: Those born to To no Naishi in particular were graceful in appearance, gentle and wise in character, and each one was outstanding.

units.source_text: 其中三女公子和二公子由祖母花散里悉心抚育，源氏也常常见面，非常疼爱他们。

en.t: Among them, the third young lady and the second young lord were carefully raised by their grandmother Hanachirusato; Genji also saw them often and loved them dearly.

units.source_text: 至于夕雾、落叶公主、云居雁之间的纠纷如何解决，实在说不得了。

en.t: As for how the troubles among Yugiri, Princess Ochiba, and Kumoi no Kari were resolved, there is truly no way to tell it.
